_readme: Saga UI copy v1 for Flint, Ochre and Tundra. Player-facing text only. Nothing here is built, merged, tagged or pushed in the game repo. Voice: plain and clear, second person, one or two short sentences, contractions, no numbers or number words, no em dashes, no lists of three, no slogans. Opens-when lines start 'Opens when you' or 'Opens after you'.

source.placeholdersNote: 57 [PH] keys in uiHints at 3afe9da. ui.council.agenda.truce is not in uiHints; it is hardcoded in councils.js and is included beside those 57. The UI groups 1–5 tip c4daae4 had 13 [PH] keys; 7 of those were Lore headings and fallbacks later dropped from uiHints when lore-book-copy-v2 was wired. Those 7 are under placeholdersC4daae4 only.
source.pr2TipWas: ac2665d; current PR 2 tip is 3afe9da (unlock states exist, SHOW_ALL still true, no new copy keys for greyed lines or the New toast).
source.uxNote: v0.1.3a (a06f206) only adds Director approval of the choice-screen exception and a 14px minimum for map region names. Triggers are unchanged.

voice: narrator, second person, pass-2, plain and clear, contractions, no numbers or number words, no em dashes, no lists of three, no slogans

openQuestions.q: Map is a Places item in the c4daae4 and 3afe9da builds, but it is not in unlocks.js SYSTEMS and not on Ochre's 12-item rail (the Map mockup highlights Wilderness). §2 gives Map no unlock trigger, so I wrote no opens-when line. Please confirm Map is not a greyed rail section.

Achievements (Deeds) is in §2 as 'it's in Lore', with no first-use tip, and it is not on Ochre's rail or in unlocks.js. I still wrote place.deeds.opensWhen. Confirm it stays inside Lore and that the New toast is enough.

I wrote every greyed-section line from §2, not from unlocks.js. At 3afe9da, Pride becomes eligible only on a scout/border-scent receipt, not also on patrol, joining or founding. Inventory and Market become eligible on first use of the section, not on 'first item gained' or 'first trade offer'.

ui.meter.band is left blank on purpose. word-bar.js still fills {band}/{bands} with digits. The band words on this tip (Nearly yours, and the rest) should be the only caption. Please stop rendering this key as a numeric line.

ui.council.agenda.truce is still hardcoded in councils.js (lines 82 and 89), not in uiHints. ui.council.leave is also hardcoded as a fallback at line 70. 3afe9da has no string keys yet for the opens-when lines, the New toast, or the rewritten tip, and SHOW_ALL is still true so the screens do not change.
Mood word Easy is the mockup stand-in. Bond word Friendly is already a Tundra band. UX §4B asks for a mood word, but I don't have an approved mood list.

Drink and Scout the border one-liners use Ochre's action labels. Please confirm those names. Day-in-words uses 'Spring, a new day' because 'the first day' has a number word; I need the pattern for later days.

The mockup makes greyed rail items not clickable, but §1.6 and the rewritten tip say that selecting a greyed section shows what opens it (as den-locked already shows). The live tip will tell the player to select it.
